verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment praising Bevy's "Asset V2 preprocessing and .meta files." That points to a first-party asset preprocessing pipeline with per-asset settings files, which roughly maps to import presets and automated processing. Hot-reload and glTF/audio loading are adjacent runtime features and do not show import automation. missing for 10: first-party documentation of asset processors or import hooks, documented .meta preset configuration, batch or pipeline scripting for incoming assets, hands-on corroboration of automated import workflows.
